https://www.gog.com/game/miecze_valdgira

Swords of Valdgir
A classic action-adventure game for Atari in which the player journeys through a fantasy world, battling enemies to find the titular swords. Simple design, retro atmosphere, and challenging gameplay create an adventure tailored for fans of classic gaming.

Swords of Valdgir II
A continuation of adventures in the world of Valdgir — bigger, more expanded, and packed with new challenges. New locations, enemies, and puzzles make it a treat for both fans of the first installment and players discovering the series for the very first time.

Swords of Valdgir is without a doubt a true legend of the Polish retro gaming scene, having achieved cult status on 8-bit Atari computers. Both parts take players on an unforgettable journey into a dark world of sword and sorcery, where finding the titular weapon grants unimaginable power. The mechanics masterfully combine arcade elements with demanding puzzles, guaranteeing high-energy fun.
